name: TRAME
description: System-agnostic virtual tabletop with a sober cartographic visual identity (ATLAS v1.1)

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--atlas-action); color: var(--atlas-on-action); border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--atlas-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Control Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--atlas-surface-raised); color: var(--atlas-text); border: 1px solid var(--atlas-border); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--atlas-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Labeled Tactical Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--atlas-text); } .ds-input { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--atlas-surface-raised); color: var(--atlas-text); border: 1px solid var(--atlas-border); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--atlas-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Flat Structural Panel
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--atlas-surface); color: var(--atlas-text); border: 1px solid var(--atlas-border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; } .ds-panel-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--atlas-border); padding-bottom: 8px; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0; } .atlas-tabular-nums { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.northStar: The Map Is the Workspace: sober cartographic precision that recedes behind any battlemap art.
invariants: The Map-Art Independence Rule: Never apply CSS theme filters to uploaded battlemap textures.
The Single-Signal Amber Rule: Reserve --atlas-action for primary CTA, active tool, active turn, and unlocked PadlockEditMode.
The Non-Color Redundancy Rule: Pair every tactical disposition and wall kind with a distinct geometric shape or dash pattern.
The Flat-By-Default Rule: Use 1px solid --atlas-border for panels; reserve shadows strictly for floating canvas overlays.
